name: Alternating Heel Touch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet planted near your hips, and arms resting straight at your sides.
Brace your abs and lift your head and shoulder blades slightly off the floor.
Bend sideways through your obliques to reach one hand along the floor toward your same-side heel.
Glide smoothly back through center and reach toward the opposite heel, alternating sides while keeping your shoulders raised.
tips: Keep a small space between your chin and chest so your neck stays relaxed.
Move strictly side to side along the floor rather than bobbing your torso up and down.
